for tid in candidate_ids:
    tr=apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=tid, access_token=venmo_token)
    print('tid', tid, 'liked', tr.get('liked'), 'like_count', tr.get('like_count'))
    if not tr.get('liked', False):
        not_liked.append(tid)

results=[]
for tid in not_liked:
    res=apis.venmo.like_transaction(transaction_id=tid, access_token=venmo_token)
    results.append((tid,res))
    print('liked', tid, 'resp', res)
